oneLine: RPSG Group weighs 15-20% stake sale in IPL team Lucknow Super Giants.

sources.title: RPSG Group weighs 15-20% stake sale in IPL team Lucknow Super Giants

synopsis: The Sanjiv Goenka-led RPSG Group is exploring the sale of a 15% to 20% stake in the IPL cricket franchise Lucknow Super Giants. The group has started the process of appointing a banker, with Goldman Sachs emerging as the frontrunner for the mandate, though a final decision has not yet been made. RPSG is seeking a valuation of $1.5 billion to $2 billion for the franchise, which could make a 15-20% stake worth between $225 million and $400 million. The potential stake sale follows the expiry of LSG's lock-in period and comes amid a broader surge in IPL franchise valuations and recent high-value transactions in the league. The franchise is held through RPSG Sports Pvt Ltd, which is backed by RPSG Ventures Ltd and Rainbow Investments Ltd.
